scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
^FF0000Chicken Eggs^000000! Come and
buy as many Chicken Eggs
as you want, whenever you
want! Hey buddy, you wanna
take a look at the Chicken
Eggs that I'm selling?
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
^FF0000鸡蛋^000000！快来买吧！
你想买多少就买多少，
什么时候想买就什么时候买！
嘿，朋友，要不要看看
我卖的鸡蛋？

scripts.text: What are you doing?
scripts.translation: 你在做什么？

scripts.text: Why Chicken Eggs?
scripts.translation: 为什么是鸡蛋？

scripts.text: Sure, I'll buy some.
scripts.translation: 好的，我要买一些。

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
What am I--? I'm
selling Chicken Eggs!
For this special event
period, I'm selling as many
Chicken Eggs as you could
want for only 500 zeny each!
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
我在卖什么？
我在卖鸡蛋！
在这个活动期间，
你想买多少鸡蛋都可以，
每个只要500 Zeny！

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Boys, girls, friends,
family, old people, young
people, um, maybe not most
vegetarians or raw foodists,
but almost everyone likes eggs!
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
男孩、女孩、朋友、家人、
老人、年轻人，嗯，
可能除了大多数素食主义者
或生食主义者，
几乎每个人都喜欢鸡蛋！

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Can you imagine a world
without eggs? There'd be
no bread, pastries, cake
or frosting... Ice cream
would be a lot runnier...
Pranks wouldn't be as fun...
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
你能想象一个没有鸡蛋的世界吗？
那就不会有面包、糕点、蛋糕
或奶油...冰淇淋会变得很稀...
恶作剧也不会那么有趣...

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
I'm not really sure why, but
Chicken Eggs are popular
around this time of year.
They're hot items right
now, and I aim to cash in!
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
我不太清楚为什么，
但鸡蛋在这个季节很受欢迎。
它们现在是热门商品，
我要趁此大赚一笔！

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Great! How many do you
want? Remember that each
Chicken Egg is 500 zeny.
Remember that you won't
always be able to buy
Chicken Eggs so easily!
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
太好了！你要买多少个？
记住每个鸡蛋是500 Zeny。
记住你不可能总是这么容易
买到鸡蛋！

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Hey, if you're not
going to buy anything,
then would you mind getting
out of the way so I can
help out my customers?
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
嘿，如果你不打算买任何东西，
能不能让开点，
让我去服务我的顾客？

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Hey, you mind giving
me a real number? I also
can't sell you more than
1,000 Chicken Eggs at a time,
you know. C'mon, tell me how
many you want for real now.
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
嘿，你能给我一个真实的数字吗？
我也不能一次卖给你超过1,000个鸡蛋，
你知道吗。来吧，告诉我你到底要买多少个。

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
You don't have enough Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
你的Zeny不足。

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
No discount, go and get enough Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
不打折，去凑够Zeny吧。

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Hey, I know you really
want to buy some Chicken
Eggs, but you won't be able
to carry that much now. Why
don't you free up some
Inventory space first?.
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
嘿，我知道你真的很想买一些鸡蛋，
但你现在的背包装不下那么多。
为什么不先清理一下背包空间呢？

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Here's your Chicken Eggs!
I guess there's some festival
happening where you'll need
them, but I don't know anything
about that. Well, have a good
time, and I'll see you again!
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
这是你的鸡蛋！
我想你那里可能有什么节日
需要用到它们，但我对此一无所知。
好吧，祝你玩得开心，下次再见！

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Not interested in buying
Chicken Eggs, huh? Well,
word's going around that
there's some kind of festival
where they'll come in handy...
Can you really pass this up?
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
对买鸡蛋不感兴趣，是吗？
嗯，听说那里有什么节日
会用到它们...
你真的能放弃这个机会吗？

scripts.text:
[Dowdy Matron]
This festival is going
to be so much fun! Ooh!
I should buy some Chicken
Eggs to make some decorations.
scripts.translation:
[土气的主妇]
这个节日一定会非常有趣！哦！
我应该买些鸡蛋来做些装饰。

scripts.text:
[Dowdy Matron]
Speaking of which,
I've heard the nun that
can make Holy Eggs is back
in Prontera. Though, I think
she's using Chicken Eggs rather
than regular Eggs to make them.
scripts.translation:
[土气的主妇]
说到这个，
我听说能制作圣蛋的修女
回到了普隆德拉。不过，我想
她是用鸡蛋而不是普通的蛋来制作圣蛋的。

scripts.text:
[Cantankerous Geezer]
.Hey, do you know how
Chicken Eggs got to be so
expensive? I mean, 500 zeny
is a lot! I think it's because
some guy in Morocc is trying
to amass a ton of Holy Eggs!
scripts.translation:
[脾气古怪的老头]
嘿，你知道鸡蛋为什么变得这么贵吗？
我是说，500 Zeny很贵！
我觉得是因为摩洛哥有个家伙
想收集大量的圣蛋！

scripts.text:
[Cantankerous Geezer]
I don't know what he's
offering for those Holy
Eggs, but adventurers are
coming to him with Holy Eggs
in droves. I wonder what he's
giving to them in return?
scripts.translation:
[脾气古怪的老头]
我不知道他用什么来换取那些圣蛋，
但冒险者们纷纷带着圣蛋去找他。
我想知道他给他们什么作为回报？

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Hello! If you'd like,
I can take your Chicken
Eggs and transform them
into Holy Eggs. It's something
I do for others in celebration
of this holy season.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
你好！如果你愿意，
我可以把你的鸡蛋
转化为圣蛋。这是我在
这个神圣季节为他人做的事。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Holy Eggs represent
rebirth and, fittingly,
can be used to restore
life to your friends.
Would you like me to
make some for you?
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
圣蛋象征着重生，
恰如其名，
可以用来恢复同伴的生命。
需要我为您制作一些吗？

scripts.text: What do I need to make Holy Eggs?
scripts.translation: 制作圣蛋需要什么材料？

scripts.text: I want to make Holy Eggs.
scripts.translation: 我想制作圣蛋。

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再说

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
For each Holy Egg
that you want me to
make, you will need
to bring me...
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
每制作一枚圣蛋，
您都需要提供...

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
^4D4DFF1 White Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Green Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Yellow Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Holy Water^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Chicken Egg^000000.

[Nerlen]
Alright, how many
Holy Eggs would you
like me to make you?
I can only make up to
10 Holy Eggs at a time.
Enter ''0'' to cancel.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
好的，您想让我制作多少枚圣蛋？
我一次最多只能制作10枚。
输入''0''即可取消。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Oh, you changed your
mind? Feel free to visit me
whenever you want me to
make you some Holy Eggs~
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
哦，您改变主意了？
随时欢迎回来找我制作圣蛋哦~

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
I'm sorry, but I can only
make up to 10 Holy Eggs
at a time. If you wanted to
cancel, then just enter ''0.''
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
抱歉，我一次最多只能制作10枚圣蛋。
如果您想取消，请输入''0''。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough items to make
Holy Eggs. You need the
following for me to create
each Holy Egg for you.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
抱歉，您的材料不足，无法制作圣蛋。
制作每一枚圣蛋都需要以下材料。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
^4D4DFF1 White Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Green Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Yellow Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Holy Water^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Chicken Egg^000000.

[Nerlen]
I'm sorry, but you
won't be able to carry
that many Holy Eggs now...
You'd better free up more
space in your Inventory first.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
抱歉，您现在的背包空间不足，
无法携带这么多圣蛋...
请先清理一下背包空间。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Thank you!
I hope you enjoy
these Holy Eggs~
Hope you to be with God's love.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
谢谢！
希望您喜欢这些圣蛋~
愿上帝保佑您。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Alright, I understand.
May God bless you.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
好的，我明白了。
愿上帝保佑您。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
How are you doing?
Death... It's inescapable.
Even you'll die someday. But...
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
你好吗？
死亡...是无法逃避的。
你终有一天也会死去。但是...

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Oh, yes. That's it.
You have it. The egg you
hold has a secret power.
I think that... Yes. Someone
like you would understand
us, fit well into our group.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
哦，是的，就是这样。
你拥有它。你手中的蛋
拥有神秘的力量。
我想...是的。像你这样的人
会理解我们，
很适合加入我们的组织。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Why don't
you... Join us?
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
何不...加入我们？

scripts.text: What for?
scripts.translation: 为了什么？

scripts.text: Um... But you're suspicious!
scripts.translation: 嗯...但你们很可疑！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
I see I've caught your
interest! Well, if you'd
like to join us and learn
more, then why don't you
bring me 10 Holy Eggs?
That is my condition.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
看来引起了你的兴趣！
如果你愿意加入我们并了解更多，
何不给我10枚圣蛋？
这是我的条件。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Really? Well, I suppose
I can't help it. Let me
assure you that our
organization works
for the greater good.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
真的吗？好吧，
我想我也没办法。请相信我，
我们的组织
是为了更大的善。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
We should all enjoy
life while we still can.
Who knows? Perhaps
there will be other lives
to live after this one.
Perhaps, perhaps....
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
我们都应该
在还能享受的时候享受生活。
谁知道呢？
也许在这之后
还会有其他的人生。
也许，也许....

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Ah, you have returned.
Did you still wish to
join our ranks? If so,
I hope you brought the
10 Holy Eggs I require.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
啊，你回来了。
你还想加入我们吗？如果是的话，
我希望你带来了我所要求的10枚圣蛋。

scripts.text: Give Holy Eggs
scripts.translation: 交出圣蛋

scripts.text: Don't Give Holy Eggs
scripts.translation: 不交出圣蛋

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
So you do wish to
join our organization.
First, let me check if you
brought the Holy Eggs...
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
看来你是真的想加入我们的组织了。
首先，让我检查一下你是否带来了圣蛋...

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Very well. In return
for these Holy Eggs, let
me give you a small present
for joining us. Now, I can
tell you about what we do.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
很好。作为交换，
为了感谢你的加入，
让我送你一份小礼物。
现在，我可以告诉你我们做什么了。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
Excuse me, I've got--
^333333*Cough!*^000000 A... A bit of a
sore throat. Give me a sec...

[Corps Member]
Hm. You don't have enough
Holy Eggs to meet the condition
I set for you. Did you leave
them in your Storage?
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
嗯。你带来的圣蛋数量不足，
无法满足我设定的条件。
你是不是把它们留在仓库里了？

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Hm? I suppose I can't
blame you for being a bit
suspicious of us. Let me
assure you that ours is
a mission of holiness.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
嗯？我想我不怪你对我们有所怀疑。
请相信我，
我们的使命是神圣的。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
We are an organization
that is dedicated to...
Resurrecting dead heroes!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
我们是一个致力于...
复活已故英雄的组织！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Those Holy Eggs that you've
brought have the power to
restore life to the dead.
In large quantities...
They can even revive
ancient fallen heroes!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
你带来的这些圣蛋拥有赋予死者生命的力量。
如果数量足够多...
它们甚至能复活古代陨落的英雄！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
When you bring me
33 Holy Eggs, I will
enchant them so that you
can use them on areas where
ancient heroes had died.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
当你给我带来33枚圣蛋时，
我会为它们附魔，
这样你就可以在英雄陨落的地方使用它们。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Go and bring me
33 Holy Eggs! I shall be
waiting here for your return...
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
去吧，给我带来33枚圣蛋！
我会在这里等待你的归来...

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Ah, you've returned
Now, did you bring me
33 Holy Eggs for your task?
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
啊，你回来了。
现在，你带来了33枚圣蛋来完成任务吗？

scripts.text: Give Holy Eggs
scripts.translation: 交出圣蛋

scripts.text: Don't Give Holy Eggs
scripts.translation: 不交出圣蛋

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Ah, these will do!
Now, make a note of the
destination I describe as
I infuse these Holy Eggs
with additional magic.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
啊，这些就够了！
现在，请记下我描述的目标地点，
因为我要为这些圣蛋注入额外的魔力。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
You must go to the
entrance of Payon Dungeon,
where a nimble hero has fallen.
Sacrifice the Holy Eggs there,
and then return to me. Now...
Go, and bring him back to life!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
你必须去斐扬迷宫的入口，
那里有一位敏捷的英雄陨落了。
在那里牺牲圣蛋，
然后回来找我。现在...
去吧，让他复活！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Go to the 3rd level of
Izlude dungeon... A hero.
that sought wisdom perished
at the entrance to the 4th
level. Sacrifice the Holy Eggs
there, and return him to life!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
去依斯鲁得岛迷宫的第3层...
一位寻求智慧的英雄
在通往第4层的入口陨落了。
在那里牺牲圣蛋，
让他复活！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Go to the abandoned mine
dungeon where a brave hero
died to protect his comrades.
Sacrifice the Holy Eggs as soon
as you get to the 3rd floor.
Go, and bring him back to life!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
去废弃的矿洞迷宫，
那里有一位勇敢的英雄
为了保护他的同志而牺牲。
到达第3层时立即牺牲圣蛋。
去吧，让他复活！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Go to Glastheim, and
sacrifice the Holy Eggs
as soon as you enter the
2nd floor. A hero perished
there, but you shall bring
him back to the living!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
去格拉斯特海姆，
进入第2层后立即牺牲圣蛋。
一位英雄在那里陨落了，
但你会让他重返人间！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Hm? This isn't
33 Holy Eggs. Did you
leave some in your Storage?
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
嗯？这不是33枚圣蛋。
你是不是把一些留在仓库里了？

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Don't you understand
the righteousness of
our cause? Returning fallen
heroes will bring peace to
our lands much more quickly!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
你不明白我们事业的正义性吗？
让陨落的英雄复活，
将更快地为我们的土地带来和平！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Did you forget
where you must go?
Let me remind you
so that you do not
lose your way...
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
你忘了该去哪里了吗？
让我提醒你，
以免你迷路...

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
[Corps Member]
You must go to the
entrance of Payon Dungeon,
where a nimble hero has fallen.
Sacrifice the Holy Eggs there,
and then return to me. Now...
Go, and bring him back to life!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
[军团成员]
你必须去斐扬迷宫的入口，
那里有一位敏捷的英雄陨落了。
在那里牺牲圣蛋，
然后回来找我。现在...
去吧，让他复活！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
[Corps Member]
Go to the 3rd level of
Izlude dungeon... A hero.
that sought wisdom perished
at the entrance to the 4th
level. Sacrifice the Holy Eggs
there, and return him to life!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
[军团成员]
去依斯鲁得岛迷宫的第3层...
一位寻求智慧的英雄
在通往第4层的入口陨落了。
在那里牺牲圣蛋，
让他复活！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
[Corps Member]
Go to the abandoned mine
dungeon where a brave hero
died to protect his comrades.
Sacrifice the Holy Eggs as soon
as you get to the 3rd floor.
Go, and bring him back to life!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
[军团成员]
去废弃的矿洞迷宫，
那里有一位勇敢的英雄
为了保护他的同志而牺牲。
到达第3层时立即牺牲圣蛋。
去吧，让他复活！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Go to Glastheim, and
sacrifice the Holy Eggs
as soon as you enter the
2nd floor. A hero perished
there, but you shall bring
him back to the living!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
去格拉斯特海姆，
进入第2层后立即牺牲圣蛋。
一位英雄在那里陨落了，
但你会让他重返人间！

scripts.text: [Corps Member]
scripts.translation: [军团成员]

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Ah, I hope you've come
back with good news.
So did it work?
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
啊，我希望你带着好消息回来了。
那么，成功了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually...
Nothing happened....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实...
什么也没发生...

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
What? It can't be.
The magic... It should
have been powerful enough...
Well, it's too bad that we
failed. Even so, I am grateful
for all your help thus far...
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
什么？不可能。
魔法...它应该足够强大...
唉，很遗憾我们失败了。
尽管如此，我还是感谢
你迄今为止的帮助...

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
We'll investigate what
could have gone wrong,
and then try again next year.
Farewell, my friend, and I hope
that you'll assist us again.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
我们会调查哪里出了问题，
然后明年再试一次。
再见，我的朋友，
希望下次还能得到你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Shh! Tell no one
that I am here.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
嘘！别告诉任何人
我在这里。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well...
This is the place
the Corps Member
wanted me to find...
Time to use all of
these Holy Eggs.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...
这就是军团成员
让我找的地方...
是时候使用
所有这些圣蛋了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here we go...
Will this really bring
this ancient hero
back to life? I'm...
I'm kind of scared!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
开始了...
这真的能让
这位古老的英雄
复活吗？我...
我有点害怕！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333*Whew!*^000000 Nothing happened!
I guess I better go back to
that Corps Member and let
him know that it didn't work.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333*呼！*^000000 什么也没发生！
看来我最好回去告诉
那位军团成员，
没有成功。
